prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where the station?
answer: Could you tell me where the station is?

wrong.Could you tell me where is the station?: 間接問句要用「陳述句語序」，where 後面應是 the station is，不能把 is 提前。
wrong.Could you tell me where the station?: 句子少了動詞 is，where 子句不完整。

why: 放在 Could you tell me 後面的是間接問句，語序是疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞。
tip: 間接問句不倒裝：where ＋ 主詞 ＋ be。
say: Could you tell me where the station is?

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Both the email and the poster says the concert starts at 7:00.
Both the email and the poster say the concert starts at 7:00.
Both the email and the poster say the concert starting at 7:00.
answer: Both the email and the poster say the concert starts at 7:00.

wrong.Both the email and the poster says the c: Both A and B 表示兩者，是複數主詞，動詞要用 say，不能加 s。
wrong.Both the email and the poster say the co: say 後面的子句需要完整動詞，starting 單獨出現不能當子句動詞，要用 starts。

why: Both ... and ... 當主詞是複數，後面的 that 子句也要有完整動詞 starts。
tip: Both A and B 當主詞，動詞用複數。
say: Both the email and the poster say the concert starts at 7:00.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 海報寫星期六，但朋友的訊息寫星期日，你想問哪一個才對。
options: The poster says Saturday, but your message says Sunday. Which is correctly?
The poster saying Saturday, but your message say Sunday. Which one correct?
The poster says Saturday, but your message says Sunday. Which one is correct?
answer: The poster says Saturday, but your message says Sunday. Which one is correct?

wrong.The poster says Saturday, but your messa: correctly 是副詞；is 後面要接形容詞 correct，不能接副詞。
wrong.The poster saying Saturday, but your mes: saying 不能單獨當動詞，message 是單數要用 says，Which one 後面也漏了 is。

why: 兩份資料不一致時，用 but 連接對比，再用 Which one is correct? 詢問。
tip: 資料不一致，用 Which one is correct? 確認。
say: The poster says Saturday, but your message says Sunday. Which one is correct?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: I read two reviews. One says the food is great; _____ says it is too salty.
options: the other
other
others
answer: the other

wrong.other: other 前面少了 the；只剩一個特定對象時要說 the other。
wrong.others: others 是複數，但這裡兩篇評論只剩下一篇，要用單數的 the other。

why: 一共兩篇，第一篇用 one，剩下的那一篇就是 the other。
tip: 兩個中的另一個用 the other。
say: One says the food is great; the other says it is too salty.

prompt: 圖表和文章的內容不同時，這句話在說什麼？
text: The text and the chart do not agree with each other.
options: 文字和圖表的內容完全一樣
文字和圖表的內容互相矛盾
圖表是文字的翻譯版本
answer: 文字和圖表的內容互相矛盾

wrong.文字和圖表的內容完全一樣: do not agree 是「不一致」，不是「完全一樣」。
wrong.圖表是文字的翻譯版本: 句中沒有翻譯的意思；agree with each other 說的是兩者的資訊是否相符。

why: agree with 表示「與……一致」，加 not 就是兩者的資訊互相矛盾。
tip: do not agree 表示資訊對不上，要再查證。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we will move the picnic indoors.
If it rains tomorrow, we moved the picnic indoors.
If it rains tomorrow, we will move the picnic indoors.
answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will move the picnic indoors.

wrong.If it will rain tomorrow, we will move t: if 引導的條件句，即使說的是未來，也用現在式 rains，不用 will rain。
wrong.If it rains tomorrow, we moved the picni: 主要子句說的是明天的計畫，要用 will move，不能用過去式 moved。

why: 條件句用現在式代替未來，主要子句用 will＋原形。
tip: if 子句用現在式，主句用 will。
say: If it rains tomorrow, we will move the picnic indoors.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The notice on the board was written _____ the school librarian.
options: by
with
for
answer: by

wrong.with: with 表示「用某工具」，寫公告的人要用 by 引出。
wrong.for: for 是「為了」，無法表示「由誰寫的」。

why: 被動語態中，做動作的人用 by 引出。
tip: 被動句的做事者用 by。
say: by

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你在圖書館，旁邊的同學講話太大聲，你想禮貌地請他小聲一點。
options: Shut up now.
Could you keep your voice down, please?
Your voice is bigger, please.
answer: Could you keep your voice down, please?

雖然意思看得懂，但語氣非常不禮貌，不適合對同學或在公共場所使用。
bigger 不能形容聲音大小，要說 loud 或 keep your voice down。

why: Could you ... please? 是客氣的請求句型，keep your voice down 是「小聲一點」的慣用說法。
tip: 想請人小聲，用 keep your voice down。
say: Could you keep your voice down, please?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: According to the chart, the number of visitors _____ from 200 to 350 last year.
options: rises
has rise
rose
answer: rose

wrong.rises: last year 表示過去，不能用現在式 rises。
wrong.has rise: has 後面要接過去分詞 risen，而且 last year 也不適合用現在完成式。

why: last year 是明確的過去時間，所以用過去式 rose。
tip: 看到 last year 就用過去式。
say: rose

prompt: 「不要被舊資料騙了」是什麼意思？
text: Judging by the date, this chart is out of date.
options: 從日期來看，這張圖表已經過時了
從日期來看，這張圖表是最新的
圖表上沒有寫日期
answer: 從日期來看，這張圖表已經過時了

wrong.從日期來看，這張圖表是最新的: out of date 是「過時的」，不是「最新的」。
wrong.圖表上沒有寫日期: 句中說的是 judging by the date，表示有日期可以判斷，而不是沒有日期。

why: Judging by ... 是「從……來判斷」，out of date 則是資料太舊、不再適用。
tip: out of date 就是資料過期了。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: She asked me what time did the meeting start.
She asked me what time the meeting started.
She asked me what time the meeting start.
answer: She asked me what time the meeting started.

wrong.She asked me what time did the meeting s: 間接問句不用助動詞 did 倒裝，要改成 what time the meeting started。
wrong.She asked me what time the meeting start: 這是過去的事，動詞要改成過去式 started。

why: asked me what time 後面接間接問句，要用主詞＋動詞，時態配合過去。
tip: 間接問句不倒裝，時態要一致。
say: She asked me what time the meeting started.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Neither the poster nor the flyer _____ the price of the tickets.
options: mention
mentioning
mentions
answer: mentions

wrong.mention: Neither ... nor ... 的動詞跟靠近的主詞一致，flyer 是單數，所以要加 s。
wrong.mentioning: mentioning 不能單獨當句子的動詞，需要 mentions。

why: neither A nor B 的動詞配合離它最近的 B；the flyer 是單數，用 mentions。
tip: neither...nor 的動詞看後面那個主詞。
say: mentions

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 朋友問你有沒有看完第二篇文章，你還沒看完，正在讀。
options: Not yet. I'm still reading the second one.
Not yet. I still read the second one.
No yet. I'm still reading second one.
answer: Not yet. I'm still reading the second one.

still read 是現在簡單式，表示習慣；說正在進行的動作要用 am still reading。
No yet 是錯的，要說 Not yet；second one 前面還要加 the。

why: 正在進行的動作用現在進行式，Not yet 是「還沒」的慣用回答。
tip: 還沒做完：Not yet, I'm still ...ing。
say: Not yet. I'm still reading the second one.

prompt: 作者對制服的態度是什麼？
text: I believe uniforms save time in the morning and make everyone feel equal.
options: 作者反對穿制服
作者贊成穿制服
作者沒有表達任何意見
answer: 作者贊成穿制服

wrong.作者反對穿制服: save time 與 feel equal 都是正面理由，所以作者是贊成而不是反對。
wrong.作者沒有表達任何意見: I believe 明確表示作者有自己的想法，並不是沒有意見。

why: I believe 後面列出制服的優點，可以判斷作者支持制服。
tip: 看 I believe 後面的理由判斷立場。
say: I believe uniforms save time in the morning and make everyone feel equal.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Text A is about a school trip, _____ Text B is about a class party.
options: because
so
while
answer: while

wrong.because: because 表示原因，但兩篇文章是對照關係，不是因果。
wrong.so: so 表示結果，前後兩句沒有「所以」的關係。

why: while 可以連接兩個對比的內容，意思是「而」。
tip: 對比兩件事用 while。
say: while

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Each of the students has to hand in a short report.
Each of the students have to hand in a short report.
Each of the student has to hand in a short report.
answer: Each of the students has to hand in a short report.

wrong.Each of the students have to hand in a s: Each of 後面雖是複數名詞，但 each 本身是單數，動詞要用 has。
wrong.Each of the student has to hand in a sho: Each of 後面要接複數名詞 students，不能漏掉 s。

why: each of + 複數名詞，主詞視為單數，所以用 has to。
tip: each of 後面接複數名詞，動詞用單數。
say: Each of the students has to hand in a short report.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 同學問你覺得哪一篇比較有用，你覺得第二篇比較好，因為有例子。
options: I think the second one is most useful because it gives example.
I think the second one is more useful because it gives examples.
I think second one more useful because it give examples.
answer: I think the second one is more useful because it gives examples.

wrong.I think the second one is most useful be: 只比較兩篇時用 more，不是 most；examples 也要用複數。
wrong.I think second one more useful because i: 缺少 the 和 is，give 也要配合 it 加 s。

why: 比較兩個東西用 more＋形容詞，because 後面接完整的句子。
tip: 兩者比較用 more，不用 most。
say: I think the second one is more useful because it gives examples.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The more you read, _____ you learn.
options: more
the most
the more
answer: the more

wrong.more: 「越……越……」的句型兩邊都要有 the，這裡漏掉了 the。
wrong.the most: the most 是最高級，這個句型要用比較級 the more。

why: The + 比較級 ..., the + 比較級 ... 表示「越……就越……」。
tip: 越……越……：the more ..., the more ...。
say: The more you read, the more you learn.

prompt: 「這篇文章大概在講什麼？」
text: Judging from the title, this article is probably about sleep.
options: 從標題判斷，這篇文章可能和睡眠有關
作者把標題寫錯了
這篇文章一定是在談睡眠
answer: 從標題判斷，這篇文章可能和睡眠有關

wrong.作者把標題寫錯了: 句中沒有提到標題有錯，judging from 是「從……判斷」。
wrong.這篇文章一定是在談睡眠: probably 只是「可能」，不是「一定」。

why: probably 表示「大概、可能」，語氣不是百分之百肯定。
tip: probably 是可能，certainly 才是一定。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I'm used to take the MRT to school.
I'm used to taking the MRT to school.
I used to taking the MRT to school.
answer: I'm used to taking the MRT to school.

be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，不能接原形。
used to 後面接原形；而 be used to 才接 V-ing，這句兩邊都用錯了。

why: be used to + V-ing 表示「習慣於」，to 是介系詞。
tip: 習慣於做某事：be used to + V-ing。
say: I'm used to taking the MRT to school.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 朋友約你週六去看電影，但你那天要補習，想禮貌拒絕並提另一天。
options: No. I do not like movies with you.
Yes, I will go, but I will not be there.
I'm sorry, but I have cram school that day. How about Sunday?
answer: I'm sorry, but I have cram school that day. How about Sunday?

太直接又傷人，不是禮貌的拒絕方式。
前後矛盾：說會去，又說不會在那裡。

why: 先道歉、說明原因，再提出另一個時間，是客氣的拒絕方式。
tip: 拒絕時：先道歉，再給原因與替代方案。
say: I'm sorry, but I have cram school that day. How about Sunday?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Please read the instructions _____ before you start the test.
options: carefully
careful
care
answer: carefully

wrong.careful: careful 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 read，要用副詞 carefully。
wrong.care: care 是名詞或動詞，放在這裡文法不通。

why: 修飾動詞 read 要用副詞 carefully。
tip: 修飾動詞用副詞，字尾常是 -ly。
say: carefully

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: There are too much people in the room, so it is hard to hear.
There are too many people in the room, so it is hard to hear.
There are too many people in the room, so hard hear.
answer: There are too many people in the room, so it is hard to hear.

wrong.There are too much people in the room, s: people 是可數的複數，要用 many，不能用 much。
wrong.There are too many people in the room, s: so 後面是完整句子，需要 it is hard to hear，不能省略。

why: people 是可數名詞，修飾要用 many；so 後面接結果的完整句子。
tip: 可數用 many，不可數用 much。
say: There are too many people in the room, so it is hard to hear.

prompt: 這句話想告訴你什麼？
text: It says here that the shop is closed on Mondays.
options: 那家店只有星期一營業
那家店星期一開始裝修
這裡寫著那家店星期一不營業
answer: 這裡寫著那家店星期一不營業

wrong.那家店只有星期一營業: closed 是「關門」，與「營業」相反。
wrong.那家店星期一開始裝修: 句中沒有說裝修，只說星期一是 closed。

why: be closed on Mondays 的意思是每週一都休息、不營業。
tip: closed 是關門，open 才是營業。

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 電話裡你沒聽清楚對方說的話，想請對方再說一次。
options: Sorry, could you say that again?
What you say?
Say again, I am not hear.
answer: Sorry, could you say that again?

wrong.What you say?: 疑問句語序不對，而且沒有禮貌用語，聽起來很突兀。
文法錯誤：am not hear 要改成 could not hear，也缺少禮貌語氣。

why: Sorry, could you ...? 是禮貌請對方重說一次的常用說法。
tip: 沒聽清楚：Sorry, could you say that again?
say: Sorry, could you say that again?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: By the time we arrived, the tickets _____.
options: have sold out
had sold out
will sell out
answer: had sold out

wrong.have sold out: by the time we arrived 是過去的時間點，不能用現在完成式 have sold out。
wrong.will sell out: will 說的是未來，但這句話已經是過去發生的事。

why: 在過去某時間點之前已經完成的事，用過去完成式 had sold out。
tip: 過去之前已完成的事用 had + p.p.。
say: had sold out

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The teacher told us be quiet.
The teacher told to us to be quiet.
The teacher told us to be quiet.
answer: The teacher told us to be quiet.

tell sb to V，要在原形動詞前加 to。
tell 後面直接接人，不用加 to 再接 us。

why: tell + 人 + to V 是「告訴某人去做某事」。
tip: tell 某人 to V，人前面不加 to。
say: The teacher told us to be quiet.

prompt: 「however」在這裡的功能是什麼？
text: The park is free. However, parking costs $50 an hour.
options: 表示前後兩句內容有轉折或對比
表示後面是前面的原因
表示事情的結果
answer: 表示前後兩句內容有轉折或對比

wrong.表示後面是前面的原因: 原因通常用 because；however 帶有轉折的意思。
wrong.表示事情的結果: 表示結果會用 so 或 therefore，however 不是這個功能。

why: 公園免費，但停車要錢，後句和前句形成對比，所以用 however。
tip: however 引出轉折，翻成「然而」。
say: The park is free. However, parking costs $50 an hour.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The poster says the park opens at 8:00. _____, the website says 9:00.
options: Therefore
However
Because
answer: However

wrong.Therefore: therefore 表示因此，但兩份資料是互相矛盾，不是因果。
wrong.Because: Because 要連接原因子句，這裡不是原因，而且放句首語意不通。

why: 兩個來源的時間不同，要用 However 表示轉折。
tip: 資料矛盾時，用 however 帶出對比。
say: The poster says the park opens at 8:00. However, the website says 9:00.

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 老師問誰同意這個計畫，你同意，因為可以省錢。
options: I agree to the plan because it save money.
I am agree with the plan because it saves money.
I agree with the plan because it saves money.
answer: I agree with the plan because it saves money.

wrong.I agree to the plan because it save mone: it 是單數，動詞要用 saves；agree with 才是同意某個想法。
wrong.I am agree with the plan because it save: agree 本身是動詞，不能再加 am。

why: agree 是一般動詞，agree with 表示同意；because 後面接理由。
tip: agree 不加 be 動詞。
say: I agree with the plan because it saves money.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Which of the two articles do you think is better?
Which of the two articles do you think it is better?
Which of the two articles you think is better?
answer: Which of the two articles do you think is better?

wrong.Which of the two articles do you think i: think 後面的疑問詞 which 已經是主詞，不能再加 it。
wrong.Which of the two articles you think is b: 疑問句要有助動詞 do，要說 do you think。

why: 含 do you think 的疑問句，疑問詞放最前面，後面直接接動詞。
tip: Which ... do you think is ...? 不要多加 it。
say: Which of the two articles do you think is better?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: The students were asked to compare the ad _____ the news report.
options: on
with
at
answer: with

wrong.on: compare 常搭配 with 或 to，不搭配 on。
wrong.at: at 表示地點或時間，和 compare 搭配不通。

why: compare A with B 表示「把 A 和 B 做比較」。
tip: 比較兩者時用 compare A with B。
say: with

prompt: 這句話提醒讀者什麼？
text: Keep in mind that the survey only asked 20 students.
options: 調查結果非常準確
20 個學生全部同意
調查人數很少，下結論要小心
answer: 調查人數很少，下結論要小心

wrong.調查結果非常準確: 只有 20 人的調查樣本很小，不能說非常準確。
wrong.20 個學生全部同意: 句中並沒有說他們的答案是否相同。

why: Keep in mind 是「記住」，後面提醒樣本只有 20 人，結論有限。
tip: 樣本越少，結論越要保守。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Thanks for waiting. I'm sorry I'm late.
Thanks for wait. I'm sorry I late.
Thanks for waiting. I'm sorry I'm lately.
answer: Thanks for waiting. I'm sorry I'm late.

for 後面要接 V-ing，late 前面也需要 be 動詞 am。
wrong.Thanks for waiting. I'm sorry I'm lately: lately 是「最近」，表示遲到的是 late。

why: Thanks for + V-ing 表示感謝；late 是形容詞「遲到的」。
tip: late 是遲到，lately 是最近。
say: Thanks for waiting. I'm sorry I'm late.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: Would you mind _____ the window? It is cold.
options: to close
closing
close
answer: closing

wrong.to close: mind 後面接 V-ing，不接不定詞。
wrong.close: mind 是動詞，後面接動詞要用 V-ing，不能用原形。

why: Would you mind + V-ing? 是客氣請求對方做某事的句型。
tip: mind 後面接 V-ing。
say: closing

prompt: 哪一句英文最適合這個情境？
text: 你在餐廳想請服務生再給你一點水。
options: Give me more water now.
I want water more, please.
Could I have some more water, please?
answer: Could I have some more water, please?

命令語氣，在餐廳對服務生說很不禮貌。
more 的位置錯了，應該是 some more water，也不夠自然。

why: Could I have ...? 是禮貌地向人要東西的說法。
tip: 要東西：Could I have ..., please?
say: Could I have some more water, please?

prompt: 「summary」在這句話中是什麼意思？
text: Here is a summary of the main points in the article.
options: 摘要、重點整理
廣告
作者簡介
answer: 摘要、重點整理

wrong.廣告: 廣告是 advertisement；summary 是整理重點。
wrong.作者簡介: 作者簡介是 author profile；summary 是對文章內容的簡短整理。

why: a summary of the main points 就是「重點的摘要」。
tip: summary 是摘要，把重點縮短整理。

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: My brother is good at draw, but he is not interested in music.
My brother is good at drawing, but he is not interested in music.
My brother is good at drawing, but he is not interest in music.
answer: My brother is good at drawing, but he is not interested in music.

wrong.My brother is good at draw, but he is no: at 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing（drawing），不能用原形。
wrong.My brother is good at drawing, but he is: be interested in 是固定用法，要用過去分詞 interested，不是名詞 interest。

why: be good at + V-ing；be interested in + 名詞。
tip: 介系詞後面的動詞用 V-ing。
say: My brother is good at drawing, but he is not interested in music.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字詞。
text: To know more, please click the link _____ the bottom of the page.
options: in
for
at
answer: at

wrong.in: in 通常指在某空間內部，「頁面底部」固定說 at the bottom。
wrong.for: for 表示為了或給某人，不表示位置。

why: at the bottom of ... 是固定搭配，表示「在……的底部」。
tip: 位置的固定搭配：at the bottom of。
say: at
